resources.string: ReelsFeedLock detects when Instagram Reels are open and goes back to your phone\'s home screen. Feed, Stories, Direct, profile, Explore and Reels sent in chats stay available.

1. Open accessibility settings
2. Tap Installed apps (or Downloaded apps)
3. Tap ReelsFeedLock
4. Turn the switch on
5. Tap Allow when prompted
Reels are blocked. Feed, Stories, Direct, profile and Reels opened from chats keep working normally.

ReelsFeedLock uses Android's accessibility service to know whether Instagram's Reels screen is open.

• It only watches the Instagram app. No other app is monitored.
• Inside Instagram, it only checks screen identifiers (for example, whether the Reels tab is selected). It does not read or store messages, passwords or any other text.
• When it finds Reels, its only action is to go to your phone's home screen.
• No data is collected, stored or sent. The app has no internet access.

Android will show a generic warning that accessibility apps can see your screen. You can turn the service off at any time in accessibility settings.
Reels are allowed. Turn on the option below to block them again.
